title: ActiveAugment: Online Active Learning for Augmentation Selection in Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.28923v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data augmentation is a cornerstone of deep learning pipelines, yet existing strategies treat it as a static, model-agnostic preprocessing step, either relying on expensive dataset-specific policy search or applying transformations uniformly at random, regardless of what the model has already learned. We introduce ActiveAugment, a unified framework that treats augmentation selection as an online active learning problem. For each training minibatch, ActiveAugment generates a pool of candidate augmented views and scores each candidate using a combination of the model's predictive uncertainty and the feature discrepancy induced by the augmentation. translated_title: ActiveAugment：深度学习中基于在线主动学习的增强选择方法
translated_abstract: 数据增强是深度学习流程的基石，然而现有策略将其视为静态的、与模型无关的预处理步骤，要么依赖昂贵的数据集特定策略搜索，要么不加区分地随机均匀应用变换，而完全不考虑模型已经学到了什么。我们提出ActiveAugment，这是一个将增强选择视为在线主动学习问题的统一框架。对于每个训练小批量，ActiveAugment生成一个候选增强视图池，并结合模型的预测不确定性和增强所引起的特征差异对每个候选进行评分。系统为每个样本选择使当前模型最脆弱的那种增强，然后通过联合监督分类与监督对比目标对模型进行训练，该目标在保持类间可分性的同时，强制模型实现对所选增强的类内不变性。
tldr: ActiveAugment将数据增强选择建模为在线主动学习问题，通过模型的预测不确定性与特征差异为每个样本动态挑选使其最脆弱的增强，并以联合监督分类与对比学习目标进行训练，从而实现自适应的数据增强。
en_tdlr: ActiveAugment reframes augmentation selection as an online active learning problem, dynamically selecting per sample the augmentation under which the model is most fragile using predictive uncertainty and feature discrepancy, and trains with a joint supervised classification and contrastive objective.
